caption: the jab is the most important punch in boxing #boxing #jab #boxingtips #boxingtraining #boxer

slides.needs: boxer throwing jab, side silhouette, ring lights
slides.text: Here's exactly why your jab isn't working...
You only throw it once. Double it, triple it, change the speed.
It comes back low. Bring it home on the same line it went out.
You don't step with it. A jab without footwork falls short.

slides.needs: boxer hitting body of heavy bag
slides.text: You only aim at the head. Jab the body, then go back upstairs.
